sources.title: Robust Human Motion Forecasting using Transformer-based Model
sources.snippet: Our proposed model, named as 2 Channel-Transformer (2CH-TR), allows to cope with high levels of occlusions through its independence in 2 channels, and promotes the 3D motion forecasting, taking into account its applicability in the field of robotics.
